stories.title: Define Manifest Snapshot Freshness Schema and Persistence Contract
stories.description: Define and standardize schema for manifest snapshot metadata including generated_at (ISO timestamp), ttl_seconds, file_count, and sha256_root hash; ensure compatibility with manifest_generator output and brain_snapshot persistence structure.

stories.title: Implement Manifest Freshness Evaluation Engine
stories.description: Implement logic to evaluate manifest freshness using TTL expiration, generated_at age, and SHA-256 hash comparison by recomputing current filesystem state via manifest_generator; explicitly handle partial mismatch and missing snapshot edge cases.

stories.title: Expose Manifest Freshness Status via Internal Service Contract
stories.description: Provide an internal callable service returning freshness status (fresh, stale, regenerate_required) and metadata (age_seconds, ttl_seconds, hash_match, last_generated_at) for use by dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo without introducing any external or public API surface.

stories.title: Integrate Freshness Enforcement into Execution Pipelines
stories.description: Integrate freshness checks into dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo to enforce pre-execution validation, triggering existing manifest regeneration logic or safely short-circuiting execution when stale; must reuse existing pipeline hooks only and not introduce new orchestration paths.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Manifest Freshness and Enforcement
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating schema integrity, TTL expiration, full and partial hash mismatch detection, missing snapshot handling, and enforcement behavior across dev_pipeline, brain_runner, and sync_to_mongo pre-execution checks.
